data_source: real: images of the old D2 test set and the features the original scripts stored for them

preprocessing.deepprint: compilation images: cv2.imread(path, IMREAD_GRAYSCALE), the full image (no footer crop, as flx's loaders for real data), to_tensor; flx LazilyAllocatedBinarizer(5.0); one zero column (taller) or row (wider) appended only when the height-width difference is odd, because flx asserts a square after symmetric padding; flx pad_and_resize_to_deepprint_input_size (zero padding to a square, antialiased resize to 299 x 299); DeepPrint_TexMinu(num_training_subjects=8000, num_dims=256), released best_model.pyt, eval; feature = concat(texture 256, minutia 256) via flx extract_embeddings and EmbeddingLoader.combine
preprocessing.deepprint_parity: parity images of the old corpus: the reference loader flx SFingeLoader._load_image (cv2.imread(path, IMREAD_GRAYSCALE), bottom 32 rows cropped: the SFinGe footer, to_tensor), then the same chain as for compilation images
preprocessing.fingervit: PIL Image.open(path).convert('RGB'); torchvision Resize((224, 224)), ToTensor, Normalize(mean=[0.761, 0.760, 0.760], std=[0.287, 0.287, 0.288]); AutoModel.from_pretrained(finger-vit_giant), eval, no_grad; feature = last_hidden_state[:, 0] (CLS)
preprocessing.stored: each row L2-normalised, float32; row i belongs to manifest row i
